about: Words the question itself already contains are not required again (removed from 'skip' after run 3). Test set for Ask the app (server/app/rag/manual_qa.py, run_help_eval.py). Each item: the question, the screen the user has open (page), whether the manual covers it, the manual sections the answer should be based on (any one is enough), words the answer must contain (button or tab names, as the manual writes them; any spelling case), and the language of the answer. Typical questions of authors, page-context questions, one in German, and questions the manual does not cover or that are not about the app.
